items.titleArabic: المستقبل في المشاريع: will وbe going to
items.titleEnglish: The future in projects: will and be going to
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
نستخدم be going to للحديث عن خطة أو نية قررناها مسبقًا: We are going to test the prototype next week. ونستخدمها أيضًا للتوقع المبني على دليل نراه الآن: Look at the schedule — we're going to miss the deadline. أما will فنستخدمها للقرار الذي نتخذه لحظة الكلام: I'll send the report now، وللوعد والعرض: I'll help you with the wiring، وللتوقع المبني على رأي أو خبرة: I think the new design will be cheaper. في اجتماعات إطلاق المشاريع ستحتاج إلى الاثنين: الخطط بـ going to، والقرارات السريعة والوعود بـ will.

الشكل (Form):
- be going to + base verb (خطة مسبقة) → We're going to order the motors on Monday.
- be going to (توقع بدليل حالي) → The battery is low. It's going to stop soon.
- will + base verb (قرار لحظي أو وعد أو عرض) → OK, I'll update the Gantt chart.
- will (توقع برأي) → I think the client will like the prototype.
- النفي: won't / am not going to
- السؤال: Are you going to ...? / Will you ...?

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We're going to finish the first prototype by the end of March. — «سننهي النموذج الأولي الأول بحلول نهاية مارس.»
2) The printer is broken? Don't worry, I'll print the drawings in the lab. — «الطابعة معطّلة؟ لا تقلق، سأطبع الرسومات في المختبر.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون will لكل حديث عن المستقبل، فيقولون عن خطة مقررة منذ أسبوع: «We will meet the client tomorrow» والأنسب «We're going to meet the client tomorrow». ويحذفون be من going to: «We going to test» والصحيح «We are going to test».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: The schedule is already fixed. We ___ test the robot next Monday.
A) will to
B) are going to
C) going to
Answer: B

2) Complete: "The phone is ringing." — "OK, I ___ answer it."
A) 'll
B) am going to be
C) going
Answer: A

3) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We going to order the motors on Monday.
B) We are going to order the motors on Monday.
C) We are going order the motors on Monday.
Answer: B

4) Complete: I think the client ___ like the new design.
A) is going
B) wills
C) will
Answer: C

5) Choose the correct negative.
A) We willn't finish the report today.
B) We won't finish the report today.
C) We don't will finish the report today.
Answer: B

6) The battery is at 2%. Choose the best prediction.
A) The robot stopping soon.
B) The robot will to stop soon.
C) The robot is going to stop soon.
Answer: C

7) Complete: "I can't open the file." — "Don't worry, I ___ send it again."
A) 'll
B) 'm going
C) going to
Answer: A

8) Choose the correct question about a plan.
A) Do you going to present the project tomorrow?
B) Are you going present the project tomorrow?
C) Are you going to present the project tomorrow?
Answer: C

9) Complete: Our team ___ build a line-following robot this semester. We decided last month.
A) will to
B) is going to
C) are going
Answer: B

10) Which sentence is a promise?
A) I'll send you the drawings tonight.
B) I sending you the drawings tonight.
C) I going to send you the drawings tonight.
Answer: A

11) Complete: She ___ lead the project. The manager announced it yesterday.
A) will going to
B) going to
C) is going to
Answer: C

12) Choose the correct sentence.
A) I think the new sensor is going be more accurate.
B) I think the new sensor will is more accurate.
C) I think the new sensor will be more accurate.
Answer: C

13) Complete: "We need someone to write the minutes." — "I ___ do it."
A) 'm going to be
B) 'll
C) did
Answer: B

14) Complete: Look at those dark clouds. The outdoor test ___ be cancelled.
A) is going to
B) will to
C) going
Answer: A

15) Choose the correct sentence for a kickoff meeting.
A) First, we are going to define the scope of the project.
B) First, we going to define the scope of the project.
C) First, we will to define the scope of the project.
Answer: A

16) Complete: The deliverables ___ be ready before the deadline, I promise.
A) will
B) are going
C) is going to
Answer: A

17) Which sentence shows a decision made at the moment of speaking?
A) We are going to use the lab next week as planned.
B) The meeting room is busy? OK, we'll use the lab.
C) We use the lab every Tuesday.
Answer: B

18) Complete: "What are your plans for the prototype?" — "We ___ print the parts next week."
A) will be to
B) going to
C) are going to
Answer: C

19) Choose the correct sentence.
A) I don't think the supplier will deliver on time.
B) I think the supplier won't to deliver on time.
C) I don't think the supplier will delivers on time.
Answer: A

20) Choose the best sentence for a project plan.
A) We will to complete the first milestone in four weeks.
B) We are going to complete the first milestone in four weeks.
C) We going to complete the first milestone in four weeks.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 4 جمل عن خطة مشروع تخرجك أو مشروع روبوت بسيط: ثلاث جمل بـ be going to للخطط، وجملة بـ will لتوقع.
2) اكتب حوارًا قصيرًا من سطرين تتخذ فيه قرارًا لحظيًا أو تعرض المساعدة باستخدام I'll.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/will
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/future-be-going-to-i-am-going-to-work

items.titleArabic: ترتيب الاجتماعات: المضارع المستمر للترتيبات والمضارع البسيط للجداول
items.titleEnglish: Arranging meetings: present continuous for arrangements, present simple for timetables
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عندما يكون الحدث المستقبلي مرتّبًا مع أشخاص آخرين (موعد محدد في التقويم) نستخدم المضارع المستمر: We're meeting the client on Thursday at 10. أما الأحداث التي تتبع جدولًا رسميًا ثابتًا مثل مواعيد القطارات أو الدورات التدريبية فنستخدم معها المضارع البسيط: The training starts at 9:00. في الأسبوع الثاني تعلمت المضارع المستمر للأفعال الجارية الآن؛ هنا نستخدمه بمعنى المستقبل، ولذلك نذكر عادةً وقتًا مستقبليًا: tomorrow, next week, on Monday. ولتغيير الموعد نستخدم reschedule أو move.

الشكل (Form):
- ترتيب شخصي: am/is/are + verb-ing + وقت مستقبلي → I'm visiting the supplier on Monday.
- جدول ثابت: present simple → The design review starts at 10:30.
- السؤال عن الترتيب → Are you doing anything on Friday afternoon?
- السؤال عن الجدول → What time does the workshop finish?
- تغيير الموعد → Can we move the meeting to Wednesday? / The meeting is rescheduled for 2 p.m.

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We're presenting the prototype to the stakeholders next Tuesday. — «سنعرض النموذج الأولي على الأطراف المعنية يوم الثلاثاء القادم.»
2) The PLC training starts at 9:00 and finishes at 12:30. — «يبدأ تدريب PLC الساعة 9:00 وينتهي الساعة 12:30.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون المضارع البسيط للترتيبات الشخصية: «I meet the client tomorrow» والأفضل «I'm meeting the client tomorrow». وينسون ذكر الوقت المستقبلي فيتغير المعنى: «We're testing the robot» تعني الآن، أما «We're testing the robot on Friday» فتعني ترتيبًا مستقبليًا.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: I ___ the supplier on Monday at 11. It's in my calendar.
A) meet
B) am meeting
C) meeting
Answer: B

2) Complete: The training session ___ at 9:00 every Tuesday.
A) is start
B) start
C) starts
Answer: C

3) Choose the correct sentence about an arrangement.
A) We visiting the factory next week.
B) We're visit the factory next week.
C) We're visiting the factory next week.
Answer: C

4) Complete: What time ___ the workshop finish today?
A) does
B) is
C) do
Answer: A

5) Complete: Are you ___ anything on Friday afternoon? I'd like to book a meeting.
A) do
B) doing
C) done
Answer: B

6) Complete: The bus to the industrial zone ___ at 7:15.
A) leaves
B) is leave
C) leaving
Answer: A

7) Choose the correct question.
A) When are you presenting your project?
B) When you are presenting your project?
C) When do you presenting your project?
Answer: A

8) Which sentence talks about a future arrangement?
A) I'm calling the client at 4 p.m. tomorrow.
B) I'm calling the client now, please wait.
C) I call the client every day.
Answer: A

9) Complete: Sorry, I can't join the video call on Thursday. I ___ a training course.
A) attending
B) 'm attend
C) 'm attending
Answer: C

10) Complete: According to the timetable, the exam ___ on 12 June.
A) are
B) is
C) be
Answer: B

11) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Our manager flying to Dubai on Sunday.
B) Our manager is fly to Dubai on Sunday.
C) Our manager is flying to Dubai on Sunday.
Answer: C

12) Complete: Can we ___ the meeting to Wednesday? Tuesday is not possible.
A) move
B) moving
C) moved
Answer: A

13) Complete: The design review ___ at 10:30 in Room B.
A) is start
B) start
C) starts
Answer: C

14) Choose the correct reply to "Are you free on Monday morning?"
A) No, I visiting a client then.
B) No, I'm visiting a client then.
C) No, I'm visit a client then.
Answer: B

15) Complete: The meeting ___ rescheduled for 2 p.m.
A) does
B) is
C) are
Answer: B

16) Choose the best email sentence.
A) We are holding the kickoff meeting on 5 May at 10:00.
B) We holding the kickoff meeting on 5 May at 10:00.
C) We are hold the kickoff meeting on 5 May at 10:00.
Answer: A

17) Complete: "What ___ you doing next weekend?" — "I'm helping my friend with his robot."
A) do
B) are
C) does
Answer: B

18) Complete: The factory ___ at 6 a.m. and closes at 10 p.m.
A) open
B) opens
C) opening
Answer: B

19) Which sentence is correct for a fixed public timetable?
A) The conference begins on 3 March.
B) The conference is begin on 3 March.
C) The conference beginning on 3 March.
Answer: A

20) Choose the best reply to reschedule politely.
A) I'm afraid I meeting another client at 3. Could we meet at 4 instead?
B) I'm afraid I'm meet another client at 3. Could we meet at 4 instead?
C) I'm afraid I'm meeting another client at 3. Could we meet at 4 instead?
Answer: C

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب رسالة قصيرة (3–4 جمل) تدعو فيها زملاءك إلى اجتماع مراجعة التصميم: استخدم المضارع المستمر للترتيب، والمضارع البسيط لوقت بداية الاجتماع ونهايته.
2) اكتب جملتين تطلب فيهما تغيير موعد اجتماع بأدب، واذكر السبب بالمضارع المستمر (I'm visiting ...).

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/present-continuous-i-am-working
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/present-simple-i-work
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/future

items.titleArabic: جمل الزمن المستقبلية: when وas soon as وbefore وafter وuntil
items.titleEnglish: Future time clauses: when, as soon as, before, after, until
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عند تخطيط تسلسل المهام في مشروع نربط بين حدثين مستقبليين: When the parts arrive, we will assemble the robot. القاعدة المهمة: بعد كلمات الزمن when, as soon as, before, after, until نستخدم المضارع البسيط وليس will، حتى لو كان المعنى مستقبلًا. أما الفعل في الجملة الرئيسية فيكون بـ will أو بصيغة الأمر أو بـ can. as soon as تعني «فور»، وuntil تعني «حتى؛ إلى أن». يمكن أن تبدأ الجملة بجملة الزمن وبعدها فاصلة، أو تأتي جملة الزمن في النهاية بدون فاصلة.

الشكل (Form):
- When + present simple, will + verb → When the motors arrive, we will test them.
- will + verb + as soon as + present simple → I'll call you as soon as the test finishes.
- Before / After + present simple → After we finish the wiring, we'll check continuity.
- until + present simple → We can't start until the client approves the design.
- مع الأمر → Send me the file when you finish.
- by + وقت (بحلول) ≠ until (حتى) → Finish it by Friday. / Wait until Friday.

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) As soon as the PCB arrives, we will solder the components. — «فور وصول اللوحة المطبوعة سنلحم المكونات.»
2) We can't program the controller until the wiring is complete. — «لا يمكننا برمجة المتحكم حتى تكتمل التوصيلات.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
الخطأ الأشهر وضع will بعد when أو as soon as: «When the parts will arrive, we will start» والصحيح «When the parts arrive, we will start». ويخلط المتعلمون بين until (حتى) وby (بحلول): «Finish the report until Friday» والصحيح «Finish the report by Friday».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: When the parts ___, we will assemble the robot.
A) will arrive
B) arrived
C) arrive
Answer: C

2) Complete: I'll call you as soon as the test ___.
A) will finish
B) finishes
C) finish
Answer: B

3) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We will start the test after the client approves the design.
B) We will start the test after the client will approve the design.
C) We start will the test after the client approves the design.
Answer: A

4) Complete: We can't start ___ the manager signs the plan.
A) by
B) while
C) until
Answer: C

5) Complete: Before you ___ the motor, check the wiring.
A) will connect
B) connect
C) connecting
Answer: B

6) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Send me the file when you will finish.
B) Send me the file when you finish.
C) Send me the file when you finished.
Answer: B

7) Complete: After we ___ the wiring, we'll check continuity.
A) will finish
B) finishing
C) finish
Answer: C

8) Complete: Please finish the report ___ Friday.
A) by
B) until
C) when
Answer: A

9) Complete: As soon as the software update ___ ready, I'll install it.
A) is
B) will be
C) be
Answer: A

10) Choose the correct sentence.
A) The robot will not move until the safety door is closed.
B) The robot will not move until the safety door will be closed.
C) The robot not move until the safety door is closed.
Answer: A

11) Complete: When I ___ the results, I'll update the Gantt chart.
A) will get
B) got
C) get
Answer: C

12) Complete: We ___ order more parts before the budget closes.
A) are
B) will
C) do
Answer: B

13) Choose the correct sentence.
A) After the frame is welded, we will paint it.
B) After the frame will be welded, we will paint it.
C) After the frame welded, we will paint it.
Answer: A

14) Complete: I'll wait here ___ the technician comes back.
A) by
B) as soon
C) until
Answer: C

15) Complete: As soon as the prototype ___, we will show it to the stakeholders.
A) works
B) will work
C) working
Answer: A

16) Which sentence is correct?
A) Before we buy the sensors, we will compare three suppliers.
B) Before we will buy the sensors, we compare three suppliers.
C) Before buy the sensors, we will compare three suppliers.
Answer: A

17) Complete: The client will receive the deliverables ___ the tests are complete.
A) until
B) by
C) when
Answer: C

18) Complete: When the lead time ___ longer than four weeks, we will look for another supplier.
A) will be
B) is
C) being
Answer: B

19) Choose the correct email sentence.
A) I will send you the test report as soon as I will receive the data.
B) I will send you the test report as soon as I receive the data.
C) I send you the test report as soon as I will receive the data.
Answer: B

20) Choose the best plan for dependent tasks.
A) We will program the PLC after the electrician will install the panel.
B) We will program the PLC after the electrician installs the panel.
C) We program the PLC after the electrician installed the panel tomorrow.
Answer: B

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب خطة من 4 خطوات لمهام مترابطة في مشروع (مثل: تصميم، طباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، تجميع، اختبار) باستخدام when وas soon as وafter وuntil.
2) اكتب جملة لزميلك تخبره فيها متى سترسل له التقرير باستخدام as soon as.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/when
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/future

items.titleArabic: الطلبات المهذبة والاقتراحات في العمل الجماعي
items.titleEnglish: Polite requests and suggestions in teamwork
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
في العمل الجماعي نحتاج إلى طلب المساعدة والملاحظات بطريقة مهذبة. للطلب نستخدم Can you ...? (عادي) وCould you ...? (أكثر تهذيبًا) وWould you mind + verb-ing? (مهذب جدًا، والموافقة عليه تكون بـ No, not at all). وللاقتراح نستخدم Let's + verb وShall we + verb? وWhy don't we + verb? وHow about / What about + verb-ing? وللعرض نستخدم Shall I ...? أو I can ... if you like. لاحظ أن الفعل بعد could وcan وshall وlet's وwhy don't we يكون في صورته الأساسية، وبعد would you mind وhow about يكون بصيغة -ing.

الشكل (Form):
- Could you + base verb ...? → Could you check my wiring diagram?
- Would you mind + verb-ing ...? → Would you mind reviewing my code?
- Let's + base verb → Let's test it again.
- Shall we + base verb ...? → Shall we start the design review?
- Why don't we + base verb ...? → Why don't we use a stepper motor?
- How about / What about + verb-ing ...? → How about meeting on Monday?
- عرض المساعدة: Shall I ...? → Shall I send the minutes?

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) Could you give me some feedback on the draft before Friday? — «هل يمكنك إعطائي بعض الملاحظات على المسودة قبل الجمعة؟»
2) Why don't we add a limit switch to stop the motor at the end of the rail? — «لماذا لا نضيف مفتاح نهاية شوط لإيقاف المحرك عند نهاية السكة؟»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يقول المتعلمون «Would you mind to review my code?» والصحيح «Would you mind reviewing my code?». ويقولون «How about meet tomorrow?» والصحيح «How about meeting tomorrow?». وتذكّر أن الطلب المباشر جدًا مثل «Give me the file» قد يبدو غير مهذب مع الزملاء، فاستخدم Could you ...? بدلًا منه.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Choose the most polite request.
A) Check my wiring diagram.
B) You check my wiring diagram.
C) Could you check my wiring diagram, please?
Answer: C

2) Complete: Would you mind ___ my code?
A) to review
B) reviewing
C) review
Answer: B

3) Complete: How about ___ on Monday morning?
A) meet
B) meeting
C) to meet
Answer: B

4) Complete: Let's ___ the test again.
A) run
B) running
C) to run
Answer: A

5) Complete: Why don't we ___ a stepper motor instead?
A) use
B) using
C) to use
Answer: A

6) Choose the correct suggestion.
A) Shall we start the design review?
B) Shall we starting the design review?
C) Shall we to start the design review?
Answer: A

7) "Would you mind closing the door?" Choose the polite reply that means "Yes, I'll do it."
A) Yes, I mind.
B) No, not at all.
C) Yes, I would.
Answer: B

8) Choose the correct offer of help.
A) Shall I sending the minutes to everyone?
B) Do I shall send the minutes to everyone?
C) Shall I send the minutes to everyone?
Answer: C

9) Complete: Could you ___ me the latest drawing?
A) send
B) sending
C) to send
Answer: A

10) Complete: What about ___ a meeting with the supplier?
A) arrange
B) arranging
C) to arrange
Answer: B

11) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Can you clarifying the second requirement, please?
B) Can you to clarify the second requirement, please?
C) Can you clarify the second requirement, please?
Answer: C

12) Which sentence is a suggestion, not a request?
A) Let's revise the draft together.
B) Could you revise the draft?
C) Would you mind revising the draft?
Answer: A

13) Complete: Would you mind not ___ the motor while I measure the current?
A) to touch
B) touch
C) touching
Answer: C

14) Choose the best way to ask your manager to approve a document.
A) Approve the test plan now.
B) Could you approve the test plan when you have a moment?
C) You will approve the test plan.
Answer: B

15) Complete: Why ___ we ask the senior engineer for feedback?
A) not
B) don't
C) doesn't
Answer: B

16) Choose the correct sentence.
A) I can helping you with the wiring if you like.
B) I can help you with the wiring if you like.
C) I can to help you with the wiring if you like.
Answer: B

17) Complete: Shall we ___ a short break?
A) taking
B) to take
C) take
Answer: C

18) Choose the best reply to "Shall we meet at 3?"
A) Yes, I shall meeting at 3.
B) Yes, let's to meet at 3.
C) Yes, that's fine. See you then.
Answer: C

19) Complete: Could I ___ your multimeter for a minute?
A) borrow
B) borrowing
C) to borrow
Answer: A

20) Choose the most professional email sentence.
A) Would you mind sending me your comments on the draft by Thursday?
B) Would you mind to send me your comments on the draft by Thursday?
C) You mind sending me your comments on the draft by Thursday?
Answer: A

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب رسالة قصيرة لزميل تطلب فيها مراجعة تصميمك باستخدام Could you وWould you mind، واقترح موعدًا باستخدام How about.
2) اكتب ثلاثة اقتراحات لتحسين عمل فريقك باستخدام Let's وWhy don't we وShall we.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/requests
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/suggestions
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/shall

items.titleArabic: المقارنة بين الخيارات الهندسية: صيغ المقارنة والتفضيل
items.titleEnglish: Comparing design options: comparatives and superlatives
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عند اختيار مكوّن أو تصميم نقارن بين الخيارات. للصفات القصيرة (مقطع واحد) نضيف -er و-est: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest. وللصفات الطويلة نستخدم more/less وthe most/the least: efficient → more efficient → the most efficient. والصفات المنتهية بـ y تتحول إلى -ier: heavy → heavier. وهناك صيغ شاذة: good → better → the best، وbad → worse → the worst. ولمقارنة التساوي نستخدم as ... as، وللنفي not as ... as. وبعد صيغة المقارنة نستخدم than: A stepper motor is cheaper than a servo motor. وللتأكيد نضع much أو a lot قبل صيغة المقارنة: much faster.

الشكل (Form):
- صفة قصيرة + -er + than → lighter than, faster than
- more / less + صفة طويلة + than → more durable than, less expensive than
- the + صفة-est / the most + صفة → the lightest, the most efficient
- صيغ شاذة: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst
- as + صفة + as / not as + صفة + as → as accurate as / not as compact as
- التأكيد: much / a lot + comparative → much cheaper

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) The aluminium frame is lighter than the steel frame, but it is less durable. — «الإطار الألمنيوم أخف من الإطار الفولاذي، لكنه أقل متانة.»
2) Option B is the most cost-effective solution because it uses fewer parts. — «الخيار B هو الحل الأكثر فعالية من حيث التكلفة لأنه يستخدم قطعًا أقل.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يجمع المتعلمون more مع -er: «more cheaper» والصحيح «cheaper». ويستخدمون from بدل than تأثرًا بالعربية «أرخص من»: «cheaper from» والصحيح «cheaper than». وينسون the مع صيغة التفضيل العليا: «It is most efficient option» والصحيح «It is the most efficient option».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: A stepper motor is ___ than a servo motor.
A) more cheap
B) cheaper
C) more cheaper
Answer: B

2) Complete: The aluminium frame is lighter ___ the steel frame.
A) from
B) than
C) that
Answer: B

3) Complete: Option C is ___ efficient option of the three.
A) most
B) the more
C) the most
Answer: C

4) Choose the correct sentence.
A) This controller is gooder than the old one.
B) This controller is better than the old one.
C) This controller is more better than the old one.
Answer: B

5) Complete: The new design is ___ than the first prototype.
A) more compact
B) most compact
C) compact more
Answer: A

6) Complete: The plastic gear is not ___ durable ___ the metal gear.
A) so / than
B) more / as
C) as / as
Answer: C

7) Complete: This is ___ battery in our lab. It lasts ten hours.
A) the better
B) the most good
C) the best
Answer: C

8) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Sensor A is as accurate than Sensor B.
B) Sensor A is accurate as Sensor B.
C) Sensor A is as accurate as Sensor B.
Answer: C

9) Complete: The second test result was ___ than the first. The error was bigger.
A) worse
B) badder
C) more bad
Answer: A

10) Complete: Steel is ___ than aluminium.
A) heavyer
B) heavier
C) more heavy
Answer: B

11) Choose the correct sentence.
A) Option B is less expensive than Option A.
B) Option B is less expensiver than Option A.
C) Option B is fewer expensive than Option A.
Answer: A

12) Complete: Which motor is ___, the 12 V motor or the 24 V motor?
A) more powerful
B) powerfuller
C) the more powerful than
Answer: A

13) Complete: The lightweight drone is ___ of the three designs.
A) the fastest
B) the faster
C) fastest than
Answer: A

14) Choose the correct comparison.
A) A brushless motor is efficienter than a brushed motor.
B) A brushless motor is more efficient than a brushed motor.
C) A brushless motor is more efficient that a brushed motor.
Answer: B

15) Complete: The cable on the left is ___ the cable on the right. Both are two metres.
A) longer as
B) as longer as
C) as long as
Answer: C

16) Complete: Option A is cheap, but it is the ___ reliable option. It often fails.
A) least
B) less
C) fewest
Answer: A

17) Choose the correct sentence.
A) The new robot arm is much faster than the old one.
B) The new robot arm is very faster than the old one.
C) The new robot arm is much more faster than the old one.
Answer: A

18) Complete: This is the ___ trade-off in the whole design: a lower price but a shorter life.
A) most big
B) biggest
C) bigest
Answer: B

19) Complete: The 3D-printed part is ___ to make than the machined part.
A) more easy
B) easier
C) easyer
Answer: B

20) Choose the best sentence for a recommendation.
A) We recommend Option B because it is most cost-effective and easiest to maintain than others.
B) We recommend Option B because it is the more cost-effective and the most easy to maintain.
C) We recommend Option B because it is the most cost-effective and the easiest to maintain.
Answer: C

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) قارن بين خيارين لمشروع (مثلًا stepper motor وservo motor) في 4 جمل باستخدام: cheaper than وmore accurate than وnot as ... as وthe most.
2) اكتب جملة توصية واحدة تختار فيها الخيار الأفضل وتذكر السبب.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/comparison-adjectives-bigger-biggest-more-interesting
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/comparison-comparisons-of-equality-as-tall-as-his-father

items.titleArabic: التعبير عن الكميات في الموارد والميزانية
items.titleEnglish: Quantifiers for resources and budget: much, many, a few, a little, enough, too
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
عند الحديث عن الموارد والميزانية نحتاج إلى التعبير عن الكمية بدقة. نستخدم many وa few وfew مع الأسماء المعدودة بصيغة الجمع: many sensors, a few bolts. ونستخدم much وa little وlittle مع الأسماء غير المعدودة: much time, a little money. تعني a few وa little «قليل لكنه كافٍ» (معنى إيجابي)، أما few وlittle بدون a فتعنيان «قليل جدًا وغير كافٍ» (معنى سلبي). وتُستخدم a lot of مع النوعين. enough تعني «كافٍ» وتأتي قبل الاسم: enough time، وtoo much وtoo many تعنيان «أكثر من اللازم». في الجمل المثبتة نفضّل a lot of، ونستخدم much غالبًا في النفي والسؤال: We don't have much time.

الشكل (Form):
- معدود جمع: many / a few / few / a lot of → many parts, a few cables
- غير معدود: much / a little / little / a lot of → much time, a little money
- السؤال: How many motors ...? / How much money ...?
- enough + noun → enough resources / not enough time
- too many + جمع / too much + غير معدود → too many meetings / too much noise
- أسماء غير معدودة شائعة: equipment, information, money, time, work, feedback, software

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We have enough budget for the sensors, but we don't have much time. — «لدينا ميزانية كافية للحساسات، لكن ليس لدينا وقت كثير.»
2) There are too many bolts in the design. We can use a few clips instead. — «يوجد عدد كبير جدًا من البراغي في التصميم. يمكننا استخدام بعض المشابك بدلًا منها.»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يضيف المتعلمون s إلى الأسماء غير المعدودة: «equipments» و«informations» و«feedbacks»، والصحيح equipment وinformation وfeedback. ويقولون «How much sensors?» والصحيح «How many sensors?». ويضعون enough بعد الاسم: «time enough» والأفضل «enough time».

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: How ___ motors do we need for the robot?
A) many
B) much
C) little
Answer: A

2) Complete: How ___ money is left in the budget?
A) many
B) much
C) few
Answer: B

3) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We need some new equipments for the lab.
B) We need a new equipments for the lab.
C) We need some new equipment for the lab.
Answer: C

4) Complete: We have ___ bolts left. Not many, but enough for today.
A) a few
B) a little
C) much
Answer: A

5) Complete: There is ___ time before the deadline. We must hurry.
A) little
B) few
C) a few
Answer: A

6) Complete: We don't have ___ resources for a second prototype.
A) enough
B) too
C) many enough
Answer: A

7) Choose the correct sentence.
A) There are too much meetings this week.
B) There are too many meetings this week.
C) There is too many meetings this week.
Answer: B

8) Complete: Could you give me ___ information about the supplier?
A) an
B) some
C) many
Answer: B

9) Complete: The manager gave us a lot of ___.
A) feedbacks
B) a feedback
C) feedback
Answer: C

10) Complete: There is ___ noise in the signal. We need a filter.
A) too many
B) enough of
C) too much
Answer: C

11) Choose the correct question.
A) How many purchase orders did you send?
B) How much purchase orders did you send?
C) How many purchase order did you send?
Answer: A

12) Complete: We need ___ more time to finish the report. Just one day.
A) a few
B) many
C) a little
Answer: C

13) Complete: ___ suppliers can deliver in one week, so we must order early.
A) Little
B) Few
C) Much
Answer: B

14) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We don't have many software experience.
B) We don't have much softwares experience.
C) We don't have much software experience.
Answer: C

15) Complete: There aren't ___ engineers on the team for this project.
A) enough
B) too
C) much
Answer: A

16) Complete: The project uses ___ of resources.
A) a many
B) a lot
C) much of
Answer: B

17) Choose the correct sentence about a shortage.
A) There are not spare parts enough in stock.
B) There are not enough spare parts in stock.
C) There is not enough spare parts in stock.
Answer: B

18) Complete: The estimate includes ___ hours of testing.
A) much
B) many
C) a little
Answer: B

19) Complete: We spent ___ money on the first prototype, so we must reduce costs now.
A) too much
B) too many
C) a few
Answer: A

20) Choose the best sentence for a resource request.
A) We need a little more sensors and a few more time to finish the prototype.
B) We need a few more sensor and a little more times to finish the prototype.
C) We need a few more sensors and a little more time to finish the prototype.
Answer: C

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب 4 جمل عن موارد مشروعك (الميزانية، الوقت، القطع، الأشخاص) باستخدام many أو much، وa few أو a little، وenough، وtoo many أو too much.
2) اكتب سؤالين لمورّد أو مدير عن الكميات باستخدام How many وHow much.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/determiners-many-much-or-a-lot-of
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/little-a-little-few-a-few
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/enough

items.titleArabic: مراجعة الأسبوع: تحديث الفريق ومناقشة الخلاف بأدب
items.titleEnglish: Week review: team updates and polite disagreement
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح القاعدة (بالعربية):
في الاجتماع الأسبوعي (stand-up أو status meeting) يقدّم كل عضو تحديثًا قصيرًا: ما أنجزه، وما يخطط له، والعوائق. تجمع هذه المهارة أدوات الأسبوع كله: be going to للخطط، وwill للقرارات والوعود، والمضارع المستمر للترتيبات، وجمل الزمن (as soon as + present)، والطلبات والاقتراحات المهذبة، والمقارنات، والكميات. وعند الاختلاف في الرأي لا نقول «You are wrong»، بل نستخدم عبارات مهذبة: I see your point, but ... / I'm not sure I agree, because ... / What if we ...? الهدف هو الوصول إلى حل وسط (compromise) يخدم المشروع.

الشكل (Form):
- ما أُنجز: Yesterday I tested ... / The frame is assembled.
- الخطة: Today I'm going to ... / I'm meeting the supplier at 2.
- العائق: The blocker is ... / We don't have enough ...
- الطلب: Could you ...? / Would you mind + verb-ing?
- الخلاف المهذب: I see your point, but ... / I'm not sure that's the best option because ...
- الحل الوسط: Why don't we ...? / What if we + present simple ...?

أمثلة من الميكاترونيك:
1) We're on track for the first milestone, but we don't have enough sensors for the second prototype. — «نحن على المسار الصحيح للمرحلة الأولى، لكن ليس لدينا ما يكفي من الحساسات للنموذج الأولي الثاني.»
2) I see your point, but the servo motor is more accurate. What if we use it only on the main axis? — «أفهم وجهة نظرك، لكن محرك السيرفو أدق. ماذا لو استخدمناه على المحور الرئيسي فقط؟»

خطأ شائع عند متحدثي العربية:
يترجم المتعلمون حرفيًا عبارات حادة مثل «You are wrong» أو «This is a bad idea» فتبدو غير مهذبة في الاجتماعات. ويضعون will بعد as soon as: «as soon as the parts will arrive». وراجع أيضًا: Would you mind + -ing، وhow many للمعدود وhow much لغير المعدود.

20 أسئلة اختيار من ثلاثة خيارات:
1) Complete: Today I ___ the wiring of the control panel. It's my plan for the day.
A) am going to finish
B) going to finish
C) am going finish
Answer: A

2) Complete: We'll start the tests as soon as the parts ___.
A) will arrive
B) arrive
C) arrived
Answer: B

3) Choose the most polite way to disagree.
A) You are wrong about the cost.
B) Your idea is bad because of the cost.
C) I see your point, but I think the cost is too high.
Answer: C

4) Complete: Would you mind ___ the minutes today?
A) writing
B) to write
C) write
Answer: A

5) Complete: The new design is ___ than the old one.
A) more light
B) lighter
C) lightest
Answer: B

6) Complete: We don't have ___ time for another design review.
A) many
B) too
C) enough
Answer: C

7) Complete: I ___ the supplier tomorrow at 10. It's arranged.
A) meeting
B) 'm meet
C) 'm meeting
Answer: C

8) Choose the correct suggestion.
A) Why don't we split the task into two parts?
B) Why don't we splitting the task into two parts?
C) Why we don't split the task into two parts?
Answer: A

9) "The printer is not working." Choose the best decision.
A) OK, I sending the file to the lab printer.
B) OK, I'm going send the file to the lab printer.
C) OK, I'll send the file to the lab printer.
Answer: C

10) Complete: How ___ action items do we have from the last meeting?
A) much
B) a lot
C) many
Answer: C

11) Choose the correct sentence.
A) We are behind schedule because there were too many design changes.
B) We are behind schedule because there were too much design changes.
C) We are behind of schedule because there were too many design change.
Answer: A

12) Complete: ___ we review the progress first?
A) Let's
B) Shall
C) Why
Answer: B

13) Choose the best way to suggest a compromise.
A) What if we use the cheaper sensor for testing and the better one for the final version?
B) What if we will use the cheaper sensor for testing and the better one for the final version?
C) What if we using the cheaper sensor for testing and the better one for the final version?
Answer: A

14) Complete: The motors have ___ lead time of all the parts.
A) the longer
B) the longest
C) most long
Answer: B

15) Complete: Could you ___ the budget before Friday?
A) approve
B) approving
C) to approve
Answer: A

16) Choose the correct sentence about a plan.
A) We going to present the results to the stakeholders next week.
B) We are going to present the results to the stakeholders next week.
C) We are going present the results to the stakeholders next week.
Answer: B

17) Complete: Option A is not ___ reliable as Option B.
A) as
B) so much
C) more
Answer: A

18) Complete: We have ___ budget left, so we can buy only one sensor.
A) few
B) little
C) many
Answer: B

19) Choose the correct status update.
A) The first milestone is complete, and we are on the track for next one.
B) The first milestone is complete, and we are on track for the next one.
C) The first milestone complete, and we on track for the next one.
Answer: B

20) Choose the best closing for a team meeting.
A) So, the action items are clear. I'll send the minutes as soon as I will get back to my desk.
B) So, the action items is clear. I send the minutes as soon as I got back to my desk.
C) So, the action items are clear. I'll send the minutes as soon as I get back to my desk.
Answer: C

كتابة قصيرة (مهمتان):
1) اكتب تحديثًا أسبوعيًا (5 جمل) لمشروعك: ما الذي اكتمل، والخطة القادمة بـ going to، وعائقًا واحدًا بـ not enough، وطلبًا مهذبًا من مديرك.
2) اكتب ردًا مهذبًا (جملتين) تختلف فيه مع اقتراح زميل وتقترح حلًا وسطًا.

مراجع:
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/future
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/requests
- https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/comparison-adjectives-bigger-biggest-more-interesting
